arg.name: output_dir
arg.description: where marker_map.yaml, survey_report.yaml and survey_data.npz are written

arg.name: node_name
arg.description: the node's name; its ~/ topics and services follow it

arg.name: dictionary
arg.description: the printed family: an OpenCV DICT_* name or tag36h11, tag25h9, ...

arg.name: marker_size
arg.description: [m] edge of the BLACK SQUARE, not of the sheet: measure it

arg.name: origin_marker
arg.description: origin_marker mode: the marker that defines the frame

arg.name: frame_id
arg.description: origin_marker mode: the frame name written to the map

arg.name: reference_frame
arg.description: align_to_track: TF frame of the reference trajectory

arg.name: pose_frame
arg.description: pose_source tf: the frame of the camera poses (map, odom, ...)

arg.name: floor_offset
arg.description: [m] how far the floor lies below base_frame (a vehicle on a stand)

arg.name: pose_sd
arg.description: pose_frame: [m] noise of the pose source per axis

arg.name: process_all
arg.description: every frame in order, over a reliable subscription (recordings)

arg.name: start_paused
arg.description: record only after ~/start (the web interface starts it)

arg.name: param_file
arg.description: YAML of node parameters, read last: its values win over the arguments
